provider_account_owner_authorization_art.rule: Artifact must prove explicit account-owner authorization for this integration. Receipt stores only SHA-256, never the artifact body.

credential_activation_artifact.rule: Artifact must prove an Asaas API credential exists/enabled in the selected environment with the credential value fully absent or redacted before collection.

provider_environment_id.rule: Environment identity must be explicit because Sandbox and Production accounts and keys are independent.

secret_boundary_ref.rule: Record only a non-secret identifier for the approved secret store/runtime boundary.

operator_redaction_confirmation.rule: Operator must explicitly confirm that the credential artifact contains no API key or secret value before a receipt may be generated.

next_sequence_after_valid_operator_recei.name: REVIEW_DIGEST_ONLY_RECEIPT
next_sequence_after_valid_operator_recei.rule: Independently review that required artifacts existed, were redacted, and hashes/environment/secret-boundary reference are coherent.

next_sequence_after_valid_operator_recei.name: PROMOTE_DEDICATED_CREDENTIAL_EVIDENCE_MIGRATION
next_sequence_after_valid_operator_recei.rule: Only after review, create a versioned migration inserting exactly one credentials_verified external-evidence row with non-secret digests and environment identifier.

next_sequence_after_valid_operator_recei.name: MERGE_GREEN_THEN_REMOTE_APPLY
next_sequence_after_valid_operator_recei.rule: Apply the exact merged migration once through Supabase.apply_migration. Never use execute_sql for DML or DDL.

next_sequence_after_valid_operator_recei.name: ACTIVATE_PROVIDER_ONLY_AFTER_REMOTE_EVIDENCE_READ
next_sequence_after_valid_operator_recei.rule: Activation remains forbidden until a fresh independent read proves the credentials_verified row exists and matches the selected provider/evidence version.

next_sequence_after_valid_operator_recei.name: WEBHOOK_AND_CHECKOUT_PROOFS_LATER
next_sequence_after_valid_operator_recei.rule: Provider activation still does not promote billing launch readiness; webhook auth/replay and checkout E2E proofs remain separately required for proof_complete.
